# Project Memory Manager

Write one memory/PROJECT_MEMORY_YYYY-MM-DD.md per Korean calendar date when authorized work changes the project. Append discrete records for decisions, files, commits, tests and observed results, deployments, blockers, security implications and next steps. Distinguish evidence from assumptions; do not claim tests passed unless verified. Never store secrets. No unattended GitHub writes or deploys.
